notes.title: The Samaritans receive the Spirit
notes.intro: Samaritans who had been baptised receive the Holy Spirit when Peter and John lay hands on them.

views.label: A basis for confirmation (chrismation)
views.summary: Catholic and Orthodox Christians see here the roots of confirmation or chrismation, completing baptism with the gift of the Spirit.

views.label: Evidence of a distinct baptism in the Spirit
views.summary: Pentecostals see a pattern of receiving the Spirit as a further experience after conversion.
views.source: Assemblies of God, Statement of Fundamental Truths, 7

views.label: A special moment uniting Samaritans with the Jerusalem church
views.summary: Many evangelicals see this as unique to the gospel crossing into Samaria, not a pattern for every believer.
